title: Director, Operations - CAM - CCM
text:
**Company Description**

Carlisle Companies is a leading manufacturer of building envelope products and solutions that make buildings more energy efficient, durable, and sustainable.

We deliver roofing, insulation, waterproofing, and architectural systems for commercial and residential projects using a focus on innovation and continuous improvement to solve today’s challenges.

We’re equally committed to our people, prioritizing safety, inclusion, career growth development, tuition assistance, and excellent benefits.

With manufacturing, engineering, R&D, and corporate functions across North America and globally, Carlisle offers stability, agility, and opportunity in a performance-driven culture. Do meaningful work and shape the future of building solutions; apply today and come grow with us.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary:**

Manage long-term manufacturing strategies and support day-to-day operational activities across the Edge Manufacturing Region within the Carlisle Architectural Metals (CAM) business unit. Ensure all facilities within the assigned region follow manufacturing best practices related to safety, quality, delivery, and cost. Lead teams with mutual trust, respect, and integrity while supporting profitable growth through operational efficiencies, continuous improvement, and cost reduction initiatives.

Facilities currently assigned to the region include Arden, NC, and Waukesha, WI. The scope of responsibility may change over time and is not limited to the facilities listed, as additional locations may be assigned based on evolving business needs.

Work Location: This role is listed as remote; however, it is preferred to be near one of the two Edge sites.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Drive results and regularly review metrics relating to Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost.
* Lead and mentor Plant Managers in achieving business targets and financial metrics.
* Support companies’ Lean initiatives (Carlisle Operating System) - to include Strategic projects, MDI, 5S, TPM, kaizen and best practice sharing amongst plants.
* Collaborate with sales, demand/supply planning, engineering, safety, quality, and other cross functional teams to proactively develop company-wide manufacturing product and service solutions.
* Drive consistency in structure and operational practices across recent acquisitions and as acquisitions of like businesses are made.
* Champion annual efforts to build the CAM operating and capital budgets.
* Responsible for analyzing technology, resource needs, and market demand to plan and assess the feasibility of company projects.
* Ensure facilities are following all OSHA and company required safety programs, policies, and practices, including but not limited to those activities to fully engage all team members.
* Ensure facilities safely follow all environmental rules in compliance with federal, state, and local laws and share best practices across the organization.
* Interview, hire, and facilitate training for additions to the operations leadership team.
* Provide regular performance updates to the senior leadership team.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Partitioner of Lean Manufacturing Concepts and Tools.
* Familiarity with plant processes, machinery, and maintenance, and lean manufacturing tools and concepts.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills including presentation, respectful debate, and meeting facilitation.
* Effective project, people, process, and budget management, hiring a skilled team, setting strategy for a large and diverse team.
* Effective Leadership through setting expectations and holding people accountable through appropriate praise and discipline.
* Ability to quickly gain input, make decisions, and assure alignment.
* Effective verbal and written communications
* Ability to effectively present to large groups.

* Analyze P&L or budget reports to assess business health and identify improvement opportunities.
* Create and maintain relationships with supporting departments, sales groups and various material and equipment suppliers.
* Team oriented and trusted leader.
* Performance Assessment, Feedback and Accountability.

**Education and Experience:**

* Required:
 + Bachelor’s Degree in an Engineering or Technical discipline with strong business focus. Masters preferred.
 + 7+ years of managing plant operations
 - Preferred: Experience with multi-site leadership
 + Strong analytical skills and strong working knowledge of data analysis.
 + Strong transferable knowledge of lean principles and continuous improvement tools.
 + Strong safety orientation and ability to hold team accountable.
 + Proven and effective decision-making skills.
 + Demonstrated ability to plan and manage operational processes for maximum efficiency and productivity.
 + Shown ability to set strategy and lead a large diverse team.
 + Solid communication skills both verbal and written.
 + Experience in integrating acquisitions a plus (but not required)

 **Additional Information**

**Working Conditions:**

* Primarily office-based, with regular exposure to manufacturing and production environments across multiple facilities.
* Standard business hours are Monday through Friday, with flexibility required to support operational and business needs.
* Additional hours, including evenings and weekends, may be necessary based on business demands and operational priorities.
* Approximately 40% travel required to support facility operations, business meetings, training, and other organizational needs.

**Physical Requirements:**

According to ADA regulations, reasonable accommodation will be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Frequency scale:** Occasionally (0–30%) | Frequently (31–60%) | Continuously (61–100%)

**LIFTING OR CARRYING**

* 1–10 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 11–20 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 21–40 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 41–50 LBS —**Occasionally**
* 51 OR MORE LBS — **Occasionally**

**PUSHING OR PULLING:**

* 1–40 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 41–50 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 51 OR MORE LBS — **Occasionally**

**OTHER PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* BENDING OR STOOPING — **Occasionally**
* REACHING ABOVE SHOULDER LEVEL — **Occasionally**

* DRIVING AUTOMATIC EQUIP. VEHICLES — **Occasionally**
* OPERATE MACHINERY OR POWER TOOLS — **Occasionally**
* CLIMBING (LADDERS, STAIRS, ETC.) —**Occasionally**

* WALKING — **Occasionally**
* STANDING — **Occasionally**
* SITTING — **Occasionally**
* WORKING IN EXTREME TEMPERATURES — **Occasionally**

* REPETTIVE MOTION INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO: WRISTS, HANDS AND/OR FINGERS) — **Occasionally**
* VISION — **Occasionally**
* HEARING — **Occasionally**
* DEXTERITY — **Occasionally**
* HAND EYE COORDINATION — **Occasionally**

**Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Used:**

* Eye protection is required on the production floor.
* Safety toe shoes (steel/composite) on the production floor.
* Other PPE as defined by management.

The employee is expected to comply with all company policies related to data security, confidentiality, and remote work standards.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We endeavor to make this site accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact careers@carlisle.com.

For more information, please review our Privacy policy.
